product.title: Together Heart Family Matching Sweaters — Crewneck Tops
product.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Soft-knit appearance based on the supplied product image; exact fiber content was not provided.
  • Family story: One unisex crewneck sweater for children and adults, ready for coordinated family photos, trips, and everyday matching.
  • Print reference: Together Heart places the word “Together” across a painted heart graphic for a warm family-first message.
  • Design details: Long sleeves, a crew neckline, ribbed trim, and a relaxed pullover shape. Pants, skirts, hats, glasses, shoes, and accessories shown in the image are styling only and are not included.
  • Care: Check the sewn-in care label first; when compatible, wash cold on gentle, use mild detergent, avoid bleach, and line dry.
  • Size range: Child 2 Years through Child 9-10 Years and Adult S through Adult 4XL, all backed by the attached source chart.

Together Heart keeps the family look simple: choose each person’s chart-backed size, then pick from White, Pink, Black, Blue, Yellow, Red, or Green. The shared heart graphic makes the colors feel coordinated while letting every family member choose a favorite.

The source chart publishes garment length, chest, shoulder, sleeve, recommended height, and recommended weight. Weight ranges were converted from jin to kilograms. Because the source omits hip and waist, child hip is derived as chest plus 4 cm with waist equal to chest; adult hip equals chest and adult waist is chest minus 12 cm. Choose by the full chart and size up when between ranges or when a roomier fit is preferred.

Key Features:

  • Seven requested colors: White, Pink, Black, Blue, Yellow, Red, and Green are kept together in one product.
  • One family graphic: The same Together heart artwork coordinates child and adult sweaters.
  • Easy pullover shape: Long sleeves, a crew neckline, and ribbed trim create a casual layer.
  • Inclusive unisex sizing: Seven child rows and seven adult rows come directly from the source sweater chart and the seller's selectable-size evidence.
  • Single-garment scope: Each selected variant includes one sweater; all other pictured pieces and accessories are styling only.

Choose each family member’s size and color to build your own Together Heart matching look.
